summary: Genuinely verifies the requirement: HARNESS.argv() (real CodexHarness, no mocks) is exercised against empty/not-json/no-payload/no-originator rollout files, all made newer than a valid interactive rollout; the no-originator case now seeds a payload with id+thread_source but no originator key (the round-2 fix), the exact nearest violating input for 'lacks a recognizable originator field' — a .get()-with-default implementation bug would resume the wrong session, so the assertion is a real counterexample, not keyword theater.
